text: Optimized DAO governance should pay members only indirectly, through fungible salary tokens issued in proportion to non fungible merit tokens, because the indirect economic effects remove corruptive elements and make the design more attack resistant and stable in the long run.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3441904
abstract: The indirect economic effects remove corruptive elements and make the governance design more attack resistant and stable in the long run.

value: bifurcated DAO designs with two disparate token types
